gloss: peak season; busy period; period of flourishing business

definitions.gloss: peak season; busy period; period of flourishing business

examples.japanese: {夏|なつ}は{観光地|かんこうち}の{繁盛期|はんじょうき}だ。
examples.english: Summer is peak season for tourist areas.

examples.japanese: {繁盛期|はんじょうき}にはアルバイトを{増|ふ}やす{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: During the busy season, we need to hire more part-time workers.

examples.japanese: {年末年始|ねんまつねんし}は{飲食店|いんしょくてん}にとって{最|もっと}も{忙|いそが}しい{繁盛期|はんじょうき}であり、{予約|よやく}が{取|と}りにくくなる。
examples.english: The year-end and New Year period is the busiest peak season for restaurants, making reservations hard to get.

notes:
Composed of {繁盛|はんじょう} (prosperity, flourishing business) + {期|き} (period). Refers to a time when business activity peaks, often due to seasonal demand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観光|かんこう}の{繁盛期|はんじょうき}: peak tourism season
- {繁盛期|はんじょうき}を{迎|むか}える: to enter the busy season
- {繁盛期|はんじょうき}に{備|そな}える: to prepare for the busy season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {繁忙期|はんぼうき}: busy period — more broadly used for any hectic time, not just business prosperity
- {閑散期|かんさんき}: slow season, off-season — the opposite
- {最盛期|さいせいき}: peak period — emphasizes the height of activity or production, used more broadly beyond business
